definition: Restated consolidated profit after tax, including a material deferred-tax credit. It is not EBITDA, pre-tax operating earnings or cash collected from rentals.

sourceLabel: SEBI-hosted issuer full red herring prospectus
location: PDF page273 / printed266 · restated profit and loss; PDF292 / printed285 · Note29, tax
notes: Source ₹ million divided by 10 for ₹ crore. FY26 PBT ₹67.656 crore plus a ₹36.643 crore deferred-tax credit gives PAT ₹104.299 crore. Note29 identifies recognition of deferred-tax assets on brought-forward losses and unabsorbed depreciation. This credit raises accounting profit; it is not additional rental sales or customer cash. No separate reportable segments or furniture/appliance profit split. The prospectus is not evidence of current exchange admission.
insight: The annual PAT is materially lifted by a deferred-tax credit. Read pre-tax earnings and rental-asset investment alongside PAT; the tax benefit should not be mistaken for additional rental operating profit.
